title: Lemon Ricotta Cookies
blurb: Ricotta in the dough keeps these dense and moist rather than crisp — they should still look a little raw on top when the bottoms are ready to come out.
steps: In a large bowl, blend the softened butter and sugar until creamy.
Add the egg, ricotta and vanilla extract. Blend until combined.

In a smaller bowl, combine the flour, baking powder and baking soda. Slowly mix the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients and blend for a few minutes until it becomes a thick dough, similar to play dough — if it seems runny, add a touch more flour.
Cover and refrigerate the dough at least an hour.
Meanwhile, combine the glaze ingredients — powdered sugar, milk and lemon zest — and keep it in the fridge until the cookies are cooled.

Once the dough has chilled, scoop with an ice cream scoop and roll into balls. Bake at 350°F for about 14 to 16 minutes — keep an eye on the bottoms, since the tops will still look raw when they're ready; pull them once the bottoms are golden brown.
Let the cookies cool completely, then dip the tops in the glaze and finish with sprinkles.
